findings.original_claim: 27A Group gifts: no more than $10 per contributor; total value cap $480.
findings.proposed_text: For a special infrequent occasion, a group including a subordinate may give a superior a gift up to the applicable minimal value ($525 effective 1 January 2026). Solicitations must be voluntary and may not suggest more than $10 per person; a person may voluntarily give more. Separate voluntary food/refreshment contributions are not subject to the $10 solicitation limit. Apply aggregation rules when donor groups overlap through a subordinate.

sources.evidence: Bulletin para 4 sets $525 from 1 Jan 2026; para 6 cancels B-54.
(a) group including subordinate ties ceiling to 5 USC 7342 minimal value; (b) $10 limits solicited nominal contribution, not unsolicited voluntary contribution.

findings.explanation: Current regulation incorporates GSA minimal value. Coursebook $480 is stale; $10 was incorrectly described as a hard contribution cap in guide.

findings.original_claim: 27A says commanders make final decisions without qualification; investigations omit OSTC.
findings.proposed_text: Commands must promptly report covered offenses to NCIS and/or OSTC under current reporting guidance and must not delay reporting to investigate or question personnel. Special trial counsel independently determines whether an offense is covered and controls specified prosecutorial decisions; commands may not take disciplinary action on covered offenses committed on or after 28 December 2023 until OSTC returns or defers them. Consult the SJA on jurisdiction and referral.

sources.evidence: Official Navy page explicitly bars command discipline pending return/deferral and says prompt report without investigation delay.

findings.explanation: Do not treat the official reporting page covered-offense table as exhaustive current law: it lacks later sexual-harassment coverage. If listing offenses, separately verify 10 USC 824a/801(17).

findings.original_claim: 27A Article31(b) summary omits nature of accusation.
findings.proposed_text: Before questioning an accused or suspected service member, give the applicable Article 31(b) warning: nature of the suspected offense, no obligation to make a statement, and that any statement may be used as evidence at court-martial. Custodial interrogation may trigger additional counsel advisements. Use the current rights form and SJA advice.

findings.original_claim: 27A notification versus board procedures implies board only when OTH possible.
findings.proposed_text: Notification procedures also permit members with six or more years of total active and/or reserve service at notification to elect an administrative board. When OTH is possible, board procedures apply regardless of service length, subject to waiver.

sources.evidence: Coursebook explicitly states 6+ year right; official whole MILPERSMAN indexed 1910-158 cross-reference corroborates for reservists, but direct 1910-402 open failed; verify current source before finalizing.

findings.explanation: Substantive rights omission. Official source retrieval still pending.

findings.original_claim: 27A NCIS sexual assault referral parenthetical says when not restricted.
findings.proposed_text: Explain that independently obtained information or a report received by command before a restricted report can still trigger NCIS notification; handle protected restricted-report information through SAPR/SJA procedures. Include weapons, ordnance and controlled-substance theft/loss among reportable events.
findings.explanation: Needs current NCIS/SAPR authority before legal correction; coursebook itself distinguishes before restriction/third-party information.

findings.original_claim: 27A blanket political activity wording covers all members/public office.
findings.proposed_text: Qualify active-duty restrictions and acknowledge reserve/nonpartisan-office exceptions; members should consult current DoDD1344.10 and ethics counsel before participation. Do not imply universal prohibition on holding every public office.
findings.explanation: Coursebook p84 says reservists have special rules; current directive text not yet re-opened in this audit.

findings.original_claim: 27A gives bare 20/50 rule and calls low-value coffee/plaques/contests non-gifts.
findings.proposed_text: Add application: aggregate gifts from one source on an occasion ($8 lanyard plus $14 notepad exceeds $20); do not pay down an over-limit gift to $20. Distinguish modest refreshments from meals and public contests from official-duty awards.
findings.explanation: Check current regulation for precise examples before expansion.
